Chapter 482 - 482 A Meal; Consumption!

Chapter 482 - 482 A Meal; Consumption!

482 A Meal; Consumption!

Lin Fan was completely oblivious to all of this.

At this moment, he, Chu Yunyue, Yang Changlin, Li Rujing, and the other employees of Flower Stem had breakfast and arrived at the sports island.

There was a beach volleyball court, baseball court, swimming pool, basketball court, and a variety of fitness equipment.

There were also many beautiful women in bikinis with hot figures.

Laughter and shouts were endless.

Some of them rushed into the sea and played with each other.

Some chased after the women while laughing non-stop.

There were people jumping up and down, constantly cheering.

There were people rolling on the beach.

These…

It was all children’s games.

However, in this place, the women were in their twenties and the men were in their thirties or forties.

This was one of the charms of the Whitehorse Manor. It had the unique power to make people return to their childlike state.

Lin Fan, Chu Yunyue, Yang Changlin, Li Rujing, and the other employees came to the spa island after playing on the sports island.

There were top-notch masseuses and beauticians here.

Their massage techniques were perfect.

They used luxury essential oils from Lancome, Dior, and other brands.

Everyone felt extremely comfortable.

They looked at the blue sky and the beach, enjoyed the perfect spa treatment, and drank high-end red wine and juice…

It was simply a heavenly enjoyment.

…

Unknowingly, the sky gradually darkened.

“There’s going to be a bonfire party on food island soon,” a man said. “Let’s go and have some fun.”

“Oh!” the woman said. “Bonfire party, that’s my favorite!”

Thus, the two of them held hands and took a seaplane to the island not far away.

Many people heard their conversation.

Lin Fan saw that Chu Yunyue seemed to be interested, so he said, “I’m a little hungry. Let’s go to the food island too.”

How could Chu Yunyue not understand that Lin Fan was taking care of her? A sweet smile appeared on her pretty face.

She held Lin Fan’s arm and said, “Okay.”

Therefore, everyone took a luxury seaplane and arrived at the food island.

Lin Fan looked into the distance. It was still early, and the bonfire party had not started yet.

He then brought everyone to the restaurant LE1947.

The decorations here were very fashionable and elegant, giving off a noble aura.

Just as Lin Fan and the rest sat down, a tall and thin waiter walked over slowly and said respectfully in English, “Do you need any help?”

Lin Fan said directly, “Give me whatever’s delicious and your signatures. Just order according to the number of people here.”

When the tall and thin waiter heard this, he said in Chinese, Alright, distinguished guests, please wait a moment.”

Even the waiters here had to be proficient in multiple languages.

The Chinese language was obviously one of them.

Not long after, top-grade foie gras, snails, M9 beef, black pearl caviar, top-grade big abalone, deep-sea sea urchin, heart-shaped eggs, bread crabs, big lobsters… as well as exquisite desserts and pastries were served.

Even though everyone was busy at the spa island, they ate whenever they were hungry.

However, after seeing these delicacies, they could not help but eat in large mouthfuls, their faces filled with satisfaction.

From time to time, they would let out a heartfelt sigh of praise.

“It’s so delicious!”

At this moment, an employee wearing pink glasses accidentally dropped a cup on the ground and broke it into pieces.

She had done something wrong and should face her mistake.

She quickly lowered her head to clean up the glass shards on the ground.

“Don’t pick them up with your hands. Be careful not to cut your fingers,” said Chu Yunyue.

As she spoke, she waved her hand into the distance and said, “Please help her deal with it.”

The waiter walked over and took a deep look at the cup on the ground. He said, “Alright.”

His movements were also very fast. He put on gloves and quickly cleaned up all the fragments.

Thus, everyone buried their heads in eating again.

When they were done, the waiter walked over again and asked, “Is there anything else you need?”

“No,” said Lin Fan.

“Okay, it’s a total of 142,000 USD. Would you like to pay by card or cash?” the waiter said.

When Lin Fan heard this, he did not have any reaction.

However, all the employees of Flower Stem widened their eyes.

142,000 USD!

If converted to Chinese currency, that would be close to one million yuan!

One million yuan for one meal!

This was indeed a little expensive.

The waiter seemed to have noticed their disbelief, so he explained, “The dishes and wine you ordered add up to a total of 12,000 dollars.

“However, the cup that you broke was a treasured cup from 1990 in Austria. If you break one, the entire set will be invalid.

“And that set costs 120,000 USD.”

Everyone looked at each other.

The eyes of the woman with pink glasses who had broken the cup were red.

She had accidentally broken something worth nearly one million yuan?

Lin Fan said, “Don’t be sad. It’s just a small matter.”

For many people, one million was a very large number.

However, it was nothing to Lin Fan.

Moreover, he was the biggest shareholder of the Whitehorse Manor.

Smashing things?

Even if they tore this place down, there would be no problem.

The waiter was worried that everyone would think that he was blackmailing them, so he said, “We have the appraisal certificate here…”

As he spoke, he seemed to be ready to take out the certificate.

At this moment, the phone in his pocket rang urgently.

Initially, the waiter was not prepared to answer the call.

After all, he still had to deal with the matter in front of him.

However, when the waiter saw the caller ID, his heart skipped a beat.

That was because… he realized that the caller was Chairman Grians.

Although the waiter was the lowest level employee of the Whitehorse Manor, he still saved all the phone numbers of the higher-ups.

However, the waiter never thought that Chairman Grians would call him one day.

This was simply… unbelievable!

He pressed the answer button excitedly and said in an excited tone, “Hello, Mr. Chairman.”

Then, Grians’ loud voice came from the phone.

“Listen, the young man sitting in front of you is the new boss of our Whitehorse Manor…”

After hanging up the phone, the waiter bent down and said in a very respectful tone, “Mr. Lin and distinguished guests, I’m sorry to have disturbed you…Do you need anything else?”
